{{Citation}}
A '''monarchy''' was a type of government with a monarch, usually a [[King/Legends|king]] or a [[Queen/Legends|queen]]. A monarch would usually exercise a degree of authority. Monarchies could be hereditary or elected. Monarchies varied in size and scope from small tribal groups with [[Chief/Legends|chieftains]] to [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] governments and even [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Empire (disambiguation)|empires]].

Most monarchical systems were limited monarchies and had powers reserved, though this was not always the case. Some monarchies were autocratic in nature, such as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|disbanded]] by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
